title: callicarpa pentandra var. paloensis
intro: Callicarpa pentandra var. paloensis, commonly known as Purple Callicarpa, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Callicarpa pentandra var. paloensis include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
